[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

# A toolchain .lgo package holding JSON-eligible records must eject its
# synthesized JSONv2 methods into a guarded extra file, not into the
# unguarded support file. The support copier shares the lowered-source
# finishing logic (JSONv2 split), so the ejected tree rebuilds with
# GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2 under both the fork and upstream Go.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^item ok name$'
stdout '^pair a b$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item_jsonv2.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/pair.go
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/pair_jsonv2.go
# item.lgo carries its own guard, so the extra file narrows it with jsonv2.
grep 'ejecttestjsonoff' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item_jsonv2.go
grep '&& goexperiment.jsonv2' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item_jsonv2.go
# pair.lgo has no guard, so the extra file carries the bare jsonv2 guard.
grep '^//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2$' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/pair_jsonv2.go
# Both methods of both records in item.lgo move to the extra file.
grep 'Item\) MarshalJSONTo' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item_jsonv2.go
grep 'Entry\) MarshalJSONTo' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item_jsonv2.go
! grep 'MarshalJSONTo' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item.go
! grep 'jsontext' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/item.go
! grep 'jsontext' out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestjson/pair.go

env GOROOT=$TESTGO_GOROOT
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestjson/item.lgo --
//go:build !ejecttestjsonoff

package ejecttestjson

// Item is a JSON-eligible record: every field carries a json tag, so
// lowering synthesizes static Marshal/Unmarshal methods for it.
type Item struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Next *Item `json:"next,omitempty"`
}

// Entry is a second eligible record in the same file, so the split
// moves more than one method pair into the extra file.
type Entry struct {
	Key   string `json:"key"`
	Value string `json:"value"`
}

func Describe(it Item) string {
	if it.Next == nil {
		return "item ok " + it.Name
	}
	return "item nested"
}

-- dep/ejecttestjson/pair.lgo --
package ejecttestjson

// Pair is an eligible record in a file without a build guard, so its
// extra file carries the bare jsonv2 guard.
type Pair struct {
	A string `json:"a"`
	B string `json:"b"`
}

func (p Pair) String() string { return "pair " + p.A + " " + p.B }

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectjsonv2

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/ejecttestjson"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(ejecttestjson.Describe(ejecttestjson.Item{Name: "name"}))
	fmt.Println(ejecttestjson.Pair{A: "a", B: "b"}.String())
}
